name: CORPHUB SOLUTION
description: Industrial and corporate project support partner in Palanpur, Banaskantha, Gujarat, India. Serving the industry for over 3 years. Single point of contact for corporate accommodation, customized staff transportation, industrial material supply, vendor management, and corporate event logistics.
slogan: CorpHub Solution — Your Requirements, Our Responsibility.

entries.name: Corporate & Industrial Accommodation Solutions
entries.description: Rental property arrangements, hotel & guest house accommodation at corporate rates with PO terms, and managed housing with housekeeping & utilities.

entries.name: Customized Corporate Transportation Solutions
entries.description: Corporate staff commute shuttles, airport transfers, outstation business travel, and long-term vehicle arrangements without fixed packages.

entries.name: Industrial Material Supply & Sourcing
entries.description: Reliable industrial material sourcing and direct supply across electrical, civil, mechanical, safety consumables and hardware.

entries.name: Vendor Management & Site Liaison
entries.description: End-to-end vendor vetting, contract administration, SLA compliance tracking, and dispute management for engineering sites.

entries.name: Corporate Event Management
entries.description: Turnkey event management for plant inaugurations, Bhoomi Pujan, corporate annual meets, vendor summits, and HSE workshops.
